title: Minimum Time to Remove All Cars Containing Illegal Goods
goal: Remove every illegal car with minimum cost using end removals or individual removals.
strategy: For each prefix, choose between paying two for a newly encountered illegal car and removing the entire prefix from the left. Combine that best prefix cost with removing the untouched suffix from the right.
